job.value: Choose a seller tool (Bump, Spotlight, Shoutout) to promote this listing

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Seller tools' over the listing 'Reformation Bee midi' and 'Promote your listing' make the purpose obvious.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Choose Bumps' sits in a 'Recommended' card, but 'Spotlight listing', 'Go to Shoutout' and the red 'Start 30-day free trial' are equally strong, so four primaries compete.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Choose Bumps' and 'Go to Shoutout' predict well, but 'Spotlight listing' reads as a noun phrase rather than saying it starts setup.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: Bump and Spotlight are explained inline, but 'CarouBiz' and the '-50%' badge on Bump appear with no context for what is discounted.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks only which tool to use, with a one-line benefit and starting price ('From 150', 'From 9 per click') for each.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Deeper explanation of each tool sits behind the 'i' icons rather than in the cards.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Bump and Spotlight fit this listing, but 'Other tools' Shoutout is profile-level and the CarouBiz subscription upsell is aimed at business sellers, not this listing.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Tool names, prices and buttons carry the choice; descriptions are one or two lines each.
